name: Lab-XCT Analysis Detail
abstract: Laboratory X-ray computed tomography analysis-specific detail properties. Discriminates on ada:componentType (XCTVolume, XCTProjectionImageSet, XCTSegmentationVolume, XCTRenderedImage, XCTQuantitativeTabular), carries analysis-level required properties (analyst, dates, sample, VOI) and per-dataset schema:additionalProperty values referencing the labxctTAPP parameterValues registry.
